name: Aether Amulet
prerequisite:
Whenever the wearer deals damage to at least 2 enemies with one attack, they gain the effect of the Assassin's Elusive Shadow ability.
For 1 round the Assassin becomes the lowest priority target for enemy attacks and gains Elusive:
the Assassin can move through enemies
the Assassin gains +AGI bonus% dodge and +PER bonus% dodge reduction
the Assassin's attacks deal +10% additional damage
all half cover provides the Assassin 50% cover efficiency
Elusive fades when the Assassin attacks.

name: Anatomist's Amulet
prerequisite: If the wearer inflicts the bleeding, burning, or toxin effect on a target, this target gets an additional +2 stacks of this effect.

name: Ancient Xenomechanism
prerequisite:
Whenever the wearer ends their turn, the deal (3 x INT bonus) energy damage (with armour penetration equal to wearer's INT to all adjacent creatures.
If the number of damaged creatures exceeds 3, the wearer suffers the staggered effect.

name: Aquila Pendant
prerequisite:
Grants +10 Willpower.
If the wearer has Conviction - Dogmatic, they also gain +5 Fellowship.

name: Blessed Bolter Casing
prerequisite: Single attacks with bolter weapons automatically hit the target.

name: Blessing of the Warp Spider
prerequisite: Whenever the wearer kills an enemy or scores a critical hit, they gain +2 movement points on their next turn.

name: Burnt Aquila Pendant
prerequisite:
+1 damage against xenos and daemons.
+Dogmatic rank fire damage against xenos and daemons.

name: Camaraderie Badge
prerequisite: When the wearer hits an enemy in melee range, the wearer's nearest ally gains (wearer's WP + FEL bonus) temporary wounds.

name: Carapace Fragment
prerequisite: This item negates all energy damage dealt to the wearer, but it cannot occur more than 3 times per combat.

name: Cassia's Gift
prerequisite: As long as Cassia remains in the party, this amulet grants both the Rogue Trader and Cassia +(Cassia's WP bonus) to all their characteristics.

name: Chain of Crystals
prerequisite:
Grants a +10 bonus to Lore (Warp).
Whenever the wearer hits a deamon or a psyker for the first time in combat, the target suffers - (Lore (Warp)/10) Willpower and Perception and -1 psy rating until the end of combat. Does not stack.

name: Chains of Domination
prerequisite: Whenever the wearer kills an enemy, they receive a stacking +5 bonus to Willpower until the end of combat.

name: Charm of Bonded Souls
prerequisite:
Requires Heretical - Votary.
Whenever the wearer's ally receives damage, the wearer gains +1 stack of the bonded souls effect until the end of their next turn.
Bonded Souls: the wearer gains a +2% bonus to damage for each stack of bonded souls.

name: Chartist's Pendant
prerequisite:
The wearer gains +5 Fellowship and +10 Commerce.
If the wearer has Dogmatic - Adherent or above, their Lore (Imperium) will depend on Fellowship instead of Intelligence.
The wearer also gains +10 Lore (Imperium).

name: Conmilitum Badge
prerequisite: When the wearer hits an enemy in melee range, all allies adjacent to the wearer gain (wearer's WP + FEL bonus) temporary wounds and perform an attack of opportunity against the enemy hit by the wearer.

name: Conversion Field
prerequisite:
Whenever the wearer suffers a critical hit for the first time in a round, all damage from this hit is prevented.
After that, a blinded negative effect is inflicted on all characters in a 2-cell radius around the wearer until the end of the wearer's next turn.

name: Daemon Tool
prerequisite: Whenever the wearer deals warp damage, the damaged character also suffers burning (3). Burning effects inflicted by the wearer have their power increased by +veil degradation.

name: Dashing Aquila
prerequisite:
The wearer gains the Dash ability that costs 0 AP and can be performed twice per round.
Whenever the wearer uses Dash, all adjacent enemies suffer -30 Perception until the start of the wearer's next turn.
Doesn't stack.

name: Dissector's Amulet
prerequisite:
All burning, bleeding, and toxin effects inflicted by the wearer have their power increased by +2.
Whenever the wearer hits an enemy, that enemy will now suffer damage from all the burning, bleeding, and toxin effects inflicted on them every time that enemy is hit by an attack.

name: Dust of Rending
prerequisite: A bag of strange dust that shimmers with impossible shades of colours that should not exist.

name: Fang of Perdition
prerequisite: The wearer gains +15 Coercion and +15 Lore (Xenos).

name: Flashlight Emitter
prerequisite: Whenever the wearer is the target of an attack of opportunity, the attacker becomes blinded for 1 turn. The wearer will perform their lowest cost AP attack against this enemy (including the ranged weapon).

name: Focus Incense
prerequisite: Each use of Revel in Slaughter increases the wearer's Perception by +10 until the end of combat. Stacks.

name: For the Defence of Cadia
prerequisite: When the wearer of this badge gains a stack of versatility, they also gain +3 momentum.

name: Fury Incarnate
prerequisite:
Whenever the wearer is under the effect of Reckless Rush:
all wearer's attacks gain +50% critical hit chance
the wearer gains +50% critical damage
all attacks against the wearer gain +50% critical hit chance and the wearer suffers +50% critical damage

name: Gem of Dark Vitality
prerequisite:
+4 maximum wounds.
When veil degradation is above 15:
+10 Toughness
Each round the wearer regenerates wounds equal to wearer's Heretical rank.

name: Grace of the Oblivious
prerequisite: The wearer gains +5 Toughness if their Intelligence is less than 35.

name: Hexagrammic Grace
prerequisite: Grants +10 Logic, +10 Coercion, and +10 Persuasion.

name: Honour Insignia
prerequisite: If only one of the wearer's Combat Tactics area is active in combat, the wearer gains +20 Intelligence and Fellowship.

name: Hope Pendant
prerequisite:
Requires Iconoclast - Votary
At the start of each turn (except for extra turns), the wearer gains +resolve momentum for each ally (including themselves) with 50% or less wounds.

name: Hypnotising Pendant
prerequisite: When the wearer successfully hits with a single-shot attack, the target suffers slowed until the wearer's next turn.

name: Invigorating Resolve
prerequisite: Whenever the wearer and allies in a 2-cells radius gain momentum, they also gain an equal amount of temporary wounds.

name: Laughing God's Pendant
prerequisite:
The wearer gains the Danse Macabre ability.
The Assassin dashes in a straight line for up to ??? cells, suffering ??? less damage from attacks of opportunity and gaining +???% dodge against the enemies they dash through until the next Assassin's turn.
If the Assassin hasn't dashed through any enemies, at the end of their turn they gain +???% cover efficiency to their cover until the Assassin moves.
Doesn't stack with itself.
After the first use, the Assassin can use this ability again for free.

name: Laurels of Command
prerequisite:
The wearer gains the Move, Move, Move! ability that costs 0 AP.
The wearer and targets of Move, Move, Move! are immune to the slowed effect until the end of round.

name: Medal of Alacrity
prerequisite: When the wearer targets an ally with the Bring It Down! ability for the first time in combat, that ally gains +1 additional action point.

name: Mystic Ward
prerequisite:
At the start of every combat, the wearer's allies gain +1 deflection equal to the wearer's psy rating.
Whenever an ally suffers any damage and loses non-temporary wounds, this effect is removed from that ally.

name: Officer's Aquila Pendant
prerequisite: The target of the wearer's Move, Move, Move! ability automatically reloads their current weapon and gains +1 AP.

name: Omnissiah Holy Symbol
prerequisite: The wearer gains +20 Tech-Use and +20 Logic. They can also reroll failed Tech-Use or Logic tests once per test.

name: Onslaught Amulet
prerequisite:
After the wearer uses Press the Advantage, if the wearer still has:
more than 5 tactical advantage stacks: the next attack ignores deflection
more than 10 tactical advantage stacks: also ignores cover
more than 15 tactical advantage stacks: also ignores dodge
If the wearer already has the Undisputed Advantage talent, then using Press the Advantage will only spend 1/4 of the tactical advantage stacks instead of 1/2.

name: Open Soul Pendant
prerequisite: The first use of each Navigator power in combat costs -1 AP less.

name: Phoenix Gem
prerequisite:
The wearer gains +20 Medicae and +20 Carouse.
Whenever the wearer uses a medikit or a stimulant for the first time in a round, it costs 0 AP.

name: Psy Focus
prerequisite:
The wearer deals an additional +(5 × psy rating) warp damage with their melee attacks.
Whenever the wearer suffers a critical hit, their dodge and armour is reduced by -30% until the end of combat.

name: Psychic Ward
effect:
Unsanctioned Psyker
(Can only be equipped by an unsanctioned psyker)
prerequisite: While veil degradation is equal to or more than 10, the wearer deals +(WP bonus + PER bonus)% additional damage with all psychic powers.

name: Requiemator
prerequisite: Whenever the wearer kills their target with a melee attack, all enemies in a 2-cell range around the wearer suffer wearer's WP bonus mental damage.

name: Sage Necklace
prerequisite: The wearer gains +15 Lore (Xenos) and + 15 Lore (Warp)

name: Seeker of the Weak
prerequisite: All enemies suffering from burning, toxin, or bleeding suffer a -30% penalty to dodge.

name: Slicing Symbol
prerequisite: Whenever the wearer uses Slash, Dash, or Kick, they gain +AGI bonus MP and +(wearer's resolve / 2 + 1) momentum.

name: Soldier Aquila Pendant
prerequisite:
Whenever the wearer hits with a ranged weapon within melee range, the target gains +1 stack of the perplexed effect.
Perplexed: this creature suffers a -10 penalty to Ballistic Skill, Weapon Skill, Intelligence, and Perception tests for each level of this effect.

name: The Last Flash
prerequisite: Whenever the wearer is the target of an attack of opportunity, the attacker becomes blinded for 1 turn.

name: The Vial of Falstow
prerequisite:
At the start of combat, the wearer gains MP equal to their resolve.
The wearer can't be slowed.
If the wearer has Dogmatic - Votary, they gain +2 resolve for each rank in Dogmatic and cannot be immobilised.

name: Unholy Relics
prerequisite: This amulet grants the wielder a +20 bonus to Coercion and a -5 penalty to Intelligence.

name: Unholy Shard
prerequisite: This amulet grants its wearer +50% resistance to toxic damage. If the wearer has Heretical - Votary, they also heal (1 wound per Heretical rank) each time they suffer toxic damage.

name: Vortex Pendant
prerequisite: The wearer gains +5 Willpower each time their abilities affect an ally. This effect remains until the end of combat. Stacks.

name: Warlord's Amulet
prerequisite: Grants +wearer's INT bonus % dodge to the wearer and their allies.

name: Withering Shard
prerequisite:
The wearer‘s Strength, Toughness, and Agility are decreased by -15.
The wearer can use heroic acts at 125 momentum instead of 175 and desperate measures at +50 momentum higher (capped at 100 momentum).
The wearer is considered as having Heretical - Adherent if they do not yet have it.

name: Wolf Tooth Necklace
prerequisite: The wearer gains +15 Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill while they have 85% wounds or more.

name: Wraithbone Necklace
prerequisite: Grants +10 Agility and Perception.

name: Yrliet's Charm
prerequisite:
The wearer gains the In My Sights ability that costs 0 AP and provides:
additional armour penetration equal to the wearer's Perception
additional dodge reduction equal to the wearer's Ballistic Skill.
The wearer also gains Aeldari Weapon Proficiency.

name: Amulet of the Indomitable Spirit
prerequisite:
Once per battle, whenever the wearer's wounds drop to 0, they regain 20% of their maximum
wounds.

name: Amulet of the Pauper Princes
prerequisite: In the first round of combat, the wearer's MP is doubled.

name: Chirurgeon's Vow
prerequisite: The wearer's Toughness is increased by +XX.

name: Denial of Nightmares
prerequisite: If worn by a psyker, the wearer gains immunity to the horrors of the warp effect.

name: Lady Theodora's Immaculacy
prerequisite: The wearer's Persuasion is increased by +XX.

name: Laughing God's Pendant
prerequisite:
The wearer gains the Danse Macabre ability.
The Assassin dashes in a straight line for up to (1 + AGI bonus / 2) cells, suffering -Assassin's Weapon Skill bonus less damage from attacks of opportunity and gaining Assassin's Weapon
Skill bonus% dodge against the enemies they dash through until the next Assassin's turn.
If the Assassin has not dashed through any enemies, at the end of their turn they gain +(2 x Assassin's AGI bonus)% cover efficiency to their cover until the Assassin moves. Does not stack with itself.
After the first use, the Assassin can use this ability again for free.

name: Martyr's Bone Charm
prerequisite: If worn by a Death Cult assassin, when the wearer is affected by blood phial, they gain +10 Toughness for 2 rounds. Does not stack.

name: Missionary Oath
prerequisite: Once per combat, if the wearer does not use any abilities during their turn, they can end their turn to immediately grant all adjacent allies an extra turn with 1 AP.

name: Relics of Unknown Saints
prerequisite: When the wearer has less than 50% wounds, every second attack against them is automatically dodged. The effect lasts for up to 2 rounds.

name: Saint's Bone Charm
prerequisite: If worn by a Death Cult assassin, the wearer gains +20 Toughness for 2 rounds when affected by blood phial. Does not stack.

name: Sire's Patronage
prerequisite:
The wearer can skip their turn to make an ally of their choice immune to all damage until the start of the wearer's next turn.
! Can only be used once per combat.

name: Starmist Scarf
prerequisite:
If the wearer is not wearing any armour, at the start of combat, they gain XX% dodge.
The wearer's psy rating is increased by +2.

name: Tarnished Breacher's Aquila
prerequisite:
Enemies within the wearer's area of attack suffer -XX% dodge, and allies within the wearer's
area of attack gain +XX% dodge for 1 round.

name: The Princess of Efreet
prerequisite: If the wearer is a Cold Trader, they gain +FEL bonus to all skills.
